target.statement: The CROSS-CHANNEL category is empty (0 segments) on all eight benchmarks under Pearson correlation with τz=3, τρ=0.1.

compute.basis: The diagnostic is a simple statistical test (z-scores, correlations) on a small dataset; the code is released and the data is public, so the main cost is downloading GECCO and running the script.

title: Anomalies in Multivariate Time Series Benchmarks Are Mostly Univariate
